text.description_html:
RK International CP-352, White Porcelain Floral Bail Cabinet Pull with Gold Lines

Highlight your funky retro flair with this White Porcelain Flower Bail Pull with Brass Lines made by RK International. The shape is reminiscent of the 1960's; and the gold detailing ramp up the glitz and glamor of this white porcelain pull. It has a 3 inch center to center. Available in polished brass, satin nickel, and oil rubbed bronze. The porcelain flower features gold detailing no matter which finish you choose.

Also Available Matching CK-322 White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Knob with Brass Lines

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP 352 Porcelain Floral Cabinet Hardware:

  • Material: Porcelain and Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Length Overall: 4-1/4"
  • Mount Diameter: 1-3/16"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
